Security

Reporting vulnerabilities and security practices.

Reporting a vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it responsibly.

Do not open a public issue.

Instead, email security@palmshed.dev with a description of the vulnerability, steps to reproduce, and potential impact.

Response

We will acknowledge receipt within 48 hours and provide a resolution timeline within 7 days.

Supported versions

Only the latest version receives security updates.
